O.content: The blue swatch is visibly labeled "Station X," the green swatch "Station Y," and the orange swatch "Station Z."

O.location: bars above Tue, Wed, and Thu labels
O.content: Each of these date positions has vertically contiguous blue, green, and orange rectangular segments.
The axis is visibly labeled "Number of Visitors" and has a printed tick labeled "4,500."
The tops of the orange segments above Tue and Wed are visibly higher on the page than the horizontal level of the 4,500 tick.
The top of the orange segment above Thu is visibly lower on the page than the horizontal level of the 4,500 tick.
The lowest printed vertical-axis tick visible is "1,000," while the bars extend to the bottom axis line below that tick.

B.text: If each date's contiguous blue, green, and orange segments are a stacked encoding of Station X, Station Y, and Station Z visitor counts on the shared vertical visitor scale, and the stack top represents their combined daily total despite the displayed axis being truncated below 1,000, then a stack top above the 4,500 tick indicates combined traffic exceeding 4,500. Under the supplied crowding-alert policy, submit exactly the dates whose combined total exceeds 4,500.
B.conditions: Applies only if the bars are additive stacks with a common zero-based quantity scale; the chart does not visibly show a zero baseline, so this is an encoding assumption.
